name: v2_roi_five_model
description: ROI-only five-model comparison of training-mean, X-only, VF PCA with and without gender, and full 60Z.
notes: The y_bar baseline predicts both holdout eyes with the flattened OD/OS response mean from the outer training fold.
PCA and all VF standardization are fit independently inside every training fold.
Each patient receives equal total PCA weight across repeated visits.
X+VF-PCA excludes gender; X+VF-PCA+gender includes gender as a separate scalar covariate.
X+60Z contains gender plus all 59 training-fold-standardized bilateral-mean VF variables.
Inner CV selects only K; ROI S, R, h, and hbar remain fixed at the existing X-only-selected values.
This experiment tests bilateral OD/OS-mean VF covariates, not eye-specific VF effects.
ridge=1e-6 is a numerical stabilization choice.
